subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should Feishu whole-message text commands during active runs be limited to a safe local fast-path subset, or should stateful commands like `/stop` and `/new` also become authorized text-slash turns that bypass the active-run queue?
rationale: Current main and the open subset PR leave different command classes with different behavior; choosing which stateful commands may bypass queue/session ordering is a product and safety decision, not a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep broad issue open and choose policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the stateful-command boundary, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85616 only as a partial safe-subset candidate.

options.title: Narrow to safe local commands
options.body: Land or adopt the safe `/status`-style fast path and move `/stop`/`/new` to a separate tracked design or bug once maintainers explicitly accept the narrower scope.

options.title: Restore all reported commands
options.body: Sponsor a broader Feishu fix that marks authorized command-only text turns and queue lanes for `/status`, `/stop`, and `/new`, with live Feishu proof for active-run behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep broad issue open and choose policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the stateful-command boundary, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85616 only as a partial safe-subset candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent source-carrier history place this person on both the Feishu command context and core fast-path surfaces that need the policy choice.
